about.quote: "THOSE WHO WORK WITH US DEVELOP EXTRAORDINARILY FAST AND EXTRAORDINARILY FAR."

senior.title: SENIOR INDUSTRIAL DESIGNER
senior.intro_passion: Do you thrive on new challenges? Are you excited about successful industrial design projects and want to develop innovations at the highest level?
senior.intro_team: Then become part of our Design Tech team!
senior.intro_company: We are the internationally leading design company for industrial companies in mechanical engineering and capital goods.
senior.location_text: Our location in Ammerbuch is situated at the foot of the Schönbuch and centrally between the university city of Tübingen and Stuttgart. Our team develops strategic and forward-looking solutions for market leaders around the world in demanding projects. For our customers, we are development partners from the first idea to the finished product!
qualification_items: Completed degree in Industrial Design or a related field
Excellent presentation skills and masterful handling of form, color, and proportions
Confident use of common software (Adobe CC, SolidWorks, Microsoft Office, etc.)
Sound knowledge of manufacturing processes and materials
Experience in planning and managing design projects
Confident appearance in customer contact and presentations
Excellent German and English skills, written and spoken
Convincing communication skills, enjoyment of teamwork, and confident appearance
Drive and responsible, structured work approach
offer_items: An exciting and diverse range of tasks
A highly professional and motivated team
Permanent employment with an unlimited contract
Short decision-making processes through flat hierarchy
Flexible working hours with a regulated 40-hour week
Attractive work environment in modern office spaces
senior.application_text: We look forward to your meaningful application with project references and work samples.
senior.contact_text: Lisa Valentina Schmid looks forward to your application.

internship.title: Industrial Design Internship
internship.intro_study: Are you studying Industrial Design and want to finally apply your skills in the real world?
internship.intro_real: At Design Tech, you don't work on practice assignments, but on real machine projects – for real clients, with real impact.
internship.intro_team: Together with experienced designers and engineers, you develop design that gets produced – and learn how technical thinking and aesthetic clarity work together.
expectations_items: Real industrial projects instead of simulation
Clear design process: From sketch to implementation
Highly motivated team with over 40 years of experience
Technological depth, creative freedom, honest feedback
requirements_items: Studies in Industrial Design or a related field
Passion for functional, sustainable, and innovative design
Basic technical understanding (e.g., CAD, Adobe CC, SolidWorks)
Enjoyment of independent work in a team
takeaways_items: A meaningful practical project for your portfolio
Real insight into the mechanical engineering industry
internship.apply_text: Send us your application for a minimum 5-month mandatory internship – or simply contact us directly.
internship.apply_bold: We look forward to your ideas!
